title: SpecRunnerEvidenceRecord
description: One line of `runs/<run_id>/attempts/<task>-<n>.jsonl` (#480 FR-06, design § 6.4): a row of one state-DB table that belongs to one terminal attempt of one task, published once through the run's publisher. `<n>` is the ordinal of the task's attempts within the invocation, the numbering closure's `attempt_ids` uses. Text fields are redacted before they are written; identity and digest fields are verbatim.

table.description: The state-DB table the row came from: the tables FR-06 / AC-21 list, plus `phase_results`. `budget_authorizations` carries task-scope rows only.

attempt.description: Ordinal of the attempt within the invocation (1-based).

row.description: The row, column name to value, as the table stores it. For `attempts`: `success`, `error_kind`, `cost_usd` (null when unreported) and the rest of the columns.
